messages.author: 033a36879f0f84e1
messages.subject: Question on deploying examples/github gists
parts:
Hey everyone, 

I'm receiving an error whenever I try to run any of the examples provided on the rstudio page. I was able to run the "Hello Shiny!" but whenever I try to run shiny::runGist('4034323') on the height/weight example (and any other example for that matter), I receive the following error message: 

Warning in .SOCK_SERVE(port) : R-Websockets(tcpserv): bind() failed
Error in createContext(port, webpage, is.binary = is.binary) : 

Unable to bind socket on port 8100; is it already in use?

Calls: runExample ... runApp -> startApp -> create_server -> createContext

Execution halted 

I had the same problem when trying to run my own app that I pasted to a github gist. When developing locally, I've been using shiny::runApp(port=8101), which works fine locally, but I get the same error when trying to run my app from gist using runGist(). 

Thanks in advance!

David

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Question on deploying examples/github gists
parts:
Most likely you've got a Shiny app running in a window you've forgotten about--if that's definitely not the case then maybe there's a piece of software on your machine that happens to use port 8100.

You can find and close that Shiny app or you can just tell runGist to use a different port using the port argument.
